ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid program under scrutiny for fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota Medicaid program for potential fraud vulnerabilities and connections to Feeding Our Future
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and investigate connections between entities
questions: What are the specific allegations against Feeding Our Future?
How much funding has been deferred due to fraud concerns?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota Medicaid program and Feeding Our Future are connected through a large-scale investigation into fraud. Following the money trail and investigating connections between entities could uncover a larger scheme.
